other_conditions: The family must not have previously availed any subsidy from the Corporation or the Government of Karnataka.
The applicant must be a member of, or obtain membership in, a self‑help group (SHG).
The SHG must have a stall or unit of at least 200 sq ft (rent/lease/own).
An agreement detailing the applicant’s participation in the SHG, the business activity, and the sharing of income must be submitted to the corporation.
The grant and loan components must be used as the primary source of finance for the activity.
If the candidate is found ineligible at any stage, the sanction by the corporation will be cancelled.
benefits_summary: Each eligible woman receives a financial assistance of Rs 25,000, comprising a Rs 15,000 subsidy and a Rs 10,000 loan at 4% interest per annum.
documents_required: Agreement stating membership in the SHG, detailed business activity description, and income‑sharing arrangement
